title: PAnDA: Parameter-Efficient冷启动推荐 with LLM-Augmented Metadata and Domain Adaptation
authors: Du, Y.; Yan, Z.; Xie, Z.
tldr: PAnDA combines LLM-augmented semantic features with a lightweight Transformer-based graph model and a domain-adaptive dual contrastive learning framework to solve cold-start recommendation across domains with minimal fine-tuning.
problem_and_motivation: Recommender systems rely on collaborative filtering requiring extensive user-item interactions, but new items suffer from sparse interactions (cold-start problem). Existing LLM-enhanced approaches face high inference costs, domain mismatch between LLM pre-training data and specific recommendation domains, and inefficient handling of cross-domain feature transfer.
approach: Augmented sparse item features using LLMs to generate comprehensive textual descriptions from raw metadata.
Built a lightweight Transformer-based graph model (PAnDA-Graph) to capture fine-grained feature interactions at item and attribute levels.
Designed a Domain-Adaptive Dual Contrastive (DADC) learning framework to align cross-domain latent feature spaces.
Implemented parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) to reduce trainable parameters and improve efficiency.
Generated five real-world datasets spanning different domains: Yelp (2020, 2021, 2022), Amazon Beauty, and Amazon Sports.
Used 70%-20%-10% training-validation-test splits with binary cross-entropy loss for optimization.
findings: PAnDA outperforms all baselines across five datasets: +2.34% on Yelp 2022, +1.10% on Yelp 2021, +0.83% on Yelp 2020, +0.37% on Amazon Beauty, +0.32% on Amazon Sports for AUC-ROC.
LLM-augmented features significantly boost cold-start performance: PAnDA-LLM achieves 0.9400 AUC on Yelp 2020 vs. 0.9334 without LLM features.
Graph attention mechanism captures rich feature interactions effectively with fewer parameters than traditional cross-attention methods.
Domain-Adaptive Dual Contrastive learning achieves up to 3.94% AUC improvement on Yelp 2020 compared to non-contrastive baselines.
PAnDA achieves 11.77x speedup over LightGCL with comparable or better performance.
PAnDA with LoRA fine-tuning achieves 0.9438 AUC on Yelp 2020 vs. 0.9255 for full fine-tuning while reducing trainable parameters from 13.08% to 2.25%.

topics.name: Real-Time Data Ingestion, Storage, and Privacy Controls
topics.justification: PAnDA uses streaming-style feature processing through a lightweight graph model with efficient parameter utilization, demonstrating real-time data handling for recommendation updates.

topics.name: Clustering and Segmentation Algorithms for Transaction Data
topics.justification: The domain-adaptive dual contrastive learning mechanism performs feature space alignment and clustering across domains, relevant to segmenting user/item interaction patterns.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: PAnDA advances cold-start recommendation by demonstrating that LLM-augmented features combined with a lightweight graph architecture and parameter-efficient fine-tuning can outperform much larger models. The domain-adaptive dual contrastive learning framework provides a principled approach for aligning cross-domain feature spaces, with practical implications for real-time recommendation systems operating across multiple domains.
directly_justifies: LLM-augmented semantic features significantly boost cold-start recommendation performance.
Lightweight graph attention captures feature interactions with fewer parameters than cross-attention methods.
Domain-adaptive contrastive learning aligns cross-domain latent spaces effectively.
LoRA fine-tuning achieves better performance than full fine-tuning while using 82.8% fewer trainable parameters.
PAnDA achieves 11.77x speedup over LightGCL while maintaining comparable performance.
limits: Experimental evaluation limited to Yelp and Amazon datasets, which may not represent all recommendation domains.
LLM inference cost for augmenting features is not fully quantified in terms of real-time latency.
The model assumes item metadata is available, which may not hold for all cold-start scenarios.
topic_relevance.topic_mapping_rationale: A systematic scan of all topic domains was conducted. Domain 5 (Anomaly Detection & Early-Warning Systems) was flagged because PAnDA's graph model processes streaming-style features with efficient parameter updates relevant to real-time data pipelines. Domain 6 (Predictive Modeling) was flagged because the contrastive learning framework performs clustering and segmentation of user/item interaction patterns across domains.

limitations: Evaluation limited to Yelp and Amazon datasets, potentially not generalizable to other domains.
LLM feature augmentation adds inference latency not fully benchmarked in real-time settings.
Assumes availability of textual item metadata for LLM processing.
